response.sql: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count, 1.0 * COUNT(oi.order_item_id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) AS order_item_share FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM product_stats GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM type_stats
